svg.text: A01 · THE KEY TO EVERY OTHER PLATE
and the mark beside the word
Count the marks against the stones. A line is five. A shell is none.
Every plate repeats this key in its lower margin.
— PICTURES IN A ROW ARE TIME PASSING —
The stone falls. It cannot fall upward — so you already know which way to read.
— AN ARROW MEANS FROM ONE THING TO ANOTHER —
A hand shown doing a thing means: this is the thing to do.
— WHAT FOLLOWS FROM WHAT YOU DO —
Both rows begin with the same water. They differ at one act, and they end differently.

THIS IS A PATIENT MESSAGE. IT WAS MADE FOR YOU, FREELY, BY PEOPLE WHO REMEMBERED FORWARD.
BUY IT · BUILD IT · BURY IT · FOR SOMEONE YOU WILL NEVER MEET
